wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 12-005 wires the savegame load path via one src/vanilla facade (wireSavegameLoad.ts) re-exporting the read-only loadgame (readLoadGame -> SaveGameReadResult|null on version mismatch/corruption, SAVEGAME_EOF 0x1d) and restore-post-load-render-audio-input-state (the fixed six-step VANILLA_POST_LOAD_SUBSYSTEM_RESET_ORDER + vanillaPostLoadResetOrderIndex/vanillaPostLoadResetSubsystemFor). VANILLA_SAVEGAME_LOAD_INVARIANTS pins five rules (state restore via readLoadGame; corrupted/wrong-version returns null; SAVEGAME_EOF 0x1d terminator; fixed six-step reset order; render->audio->input subsystem order). The focused test exercises the real reset-order index/subsystem functions (including -1/null for unknown steps), the constants, the frozen order, the multi-line-tolerant ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax). Only loadgame.ts is importer-tracked (restore-post-load module is not).
